name: Natsume Suzu
source:
Likes: Internet shopping, reading, lazing around
Dislikes: Managing schedules, nervous people
Favorite food: Ramen, instant sweet curry (mainly due to living alone)
Disliked food: Spicy food

[url=/c1792]Yuuma's[/url] 'master' in their profession as a nigashiya and in life in general. A lazy bibliophile who never met a book she didn't like and lives in a room so messy it would make a chimpanzee die of shock, she is unbelievably strong in combat and unhesitatingly does her best to help those who ask for her help. 

[Edited from [url=http://clephasstomach.blogspot.com/2011/08/review-irotoridori-no-sekai.html] Clephas' review[/url].]
